_purpose: GH-384 (D31 stage 2) second E2E fixture: an MLSN site with a nutrient genuinely BELOW the MLSN minimum, which is where decision D-6 (lift to the minimum itself, not to 1.5x it) actually bites. The Test5 - NZ fixture is ammonium-acetate and cannot exercise the MLSN branch at all.
_whyThisSample: Burns '12th Fairway' (sample 52) reads P 18 ppm against the MLSN P minimum of 21 at its pH of 6.7 — the only stored dev sample that is below an MLSN floor and also renders through the Combined export. Before GH-383 the Plan page said P required 14 (12 removal + 2.1 lift to the minimum) and the export's ANR said 21.5 (12 + 9.45, lifting to 1.5 x the minimum); both surfaces now say 14. K 195 / Ca 1400 / Mg 151 all sit above the x1.5 ceiling and suppress to 0 on both.
_source: docker exec gilba_mysql mysql -ugilba: sites.id, samples.id=52 (soil, client_uid Soil_25_zo0t), site_configs(gaip).turf, read 2026-09-09. If someone edits this sample, update currentInputs here — the harness then fails its precondition test with the drift rather than reporting a fake parity failure.
